source.citation: Breedveld, S., van den Berg, B. & Heijmen, B. (2017). An interior-point implementation developed and tuned for radiation therapy treatment planning. Computational Optimization and Applications 68(2), 209-242.
source.note: Values are the workbook's stored cell values, unmodified. Formula-derived columns (speed-up factors, time per iteration, sums) are not converted. Runs use 16 threads unless a thread count is given; 'optimal' = tiling + permutation + multiple-precision arithmetic (MPA), 'naive' = none of them. 'variants', 'scalability', 'init_ratio' and 'breakdown_s' are Mehrotra-method runs; 'variants.tile_perm_mpa', 'scalability.optimal.16' and 'init_ratio.init_ratio' are the same run as 'methods.mehrotra'.

units.site_module_timings_s: seconds, summed over the site's problems
